lines.t: I was chasing dawn in an empty sky,
Looking for love, but all I heard was bye.
I thought I found what I was searching for,
Thought I found a place to stand,
But it slipped through my fingers like sand.
(Pre-Chorus)
I didn’t notice the sky change tone
Didn’t see You working under stone
But something was growing where I thought nothing could
Flowers through concrete,
Life where I thought it couldn’t be.
Light in the broken seams of me.
I didn’t plant it, I didn’t earn it,
Still You made it bloom in the hurting.
Still You’re here when everything’s turning
I learned to breathe in a quieter way
Stopped trying to outrun yesterday
I was in the middle of my shadow,
But with Your light I can finally see.
You weren't loud like I thought You'd be.
You brought the peace and quiet to me.
Flowers through concrete,
Life where I thought it couldn’t be.
Light in the broken seams of me.
I didn’t plant it, I didn’t earn it,
Still You made it bloom in the hurting.
Still You’re here when everything’s turning
I had thought the ground was final,
That I had nowhere else to go.
But You broke through the hard ground I'd come to know.
Flowers through concrete,
Life where I thought it couldn’t be.
Light in the broken seams of me.
I didn’t plant it, I didn’t earn it,
Still You made it bloom in the hurting.
Still You’re here when everything’s turning
